notes: This prompt's own INPUTS block is unusually thin because it was designed to run inside a continuous chat session and pull almost everything else from conversation history ('pull the full ICP avatar from the ICP output earlier in this conversation', 'pull the rewritten pillar page content from earlier in this conversation', 'pull the competitor analysis from earlier in this conversation'). The context_reference fields below make those implicit reads explicit for the Context Resolver. Funnel once had no competitor stage, so its `competitor_analysis` field resolved from `unresolved_context_key`, could never auto-fill, and was removed; every funnel then printed 'STEP 2 SKIPPED'. It now has one: `competitor_analysis_funnel` (Competitor Analysis/11_Funnel.md) maps each competitor's funnel for this service, is reviewed before this stage's intake, and reaches the prompt through `competitor_funnel_analysis` below. Step 2 still states its absence when the operator supplies none, rather than inventing a competitive landscape.

fields.label: Lead Magnet Mechanic
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — describe what the visitor receives

fields.label: Target Service (if different from pillar page)
ICP Document
fields.raw_explanation: Step 1B: "Pull the full ICP avatar from the ICP output earlier in this conversation" — avatar, demographics, psychographics, pains and fears, goals, decision criteria, awareness level, research behaviour, objections, and language. "This ICP must drive every copy decision in the funnel."

fields.label: Pillar Page Content (from CRO)
fields.raw_explanation: Step 1D: "Pull the rewritten pillar page content from earlier in this conversation" — primary/secondary CTA already in use, proof points, differentiators, trust signals, and any copy or claims already established, "so the funnel reinforces, not contradicts, the pillar page."

fields.label: Locked Sections (from CRO)
fields.raw_explanation: Synthesized field — per the cross-cutting DAG rule, any section CRO marked as locked stays locked through every later stage that touches page copy, including Funnel.

fields.label: Design Tokens
fields.raw_explanation: Per Marketing_in_a_Box_Session_Context.md §6, Funnel reads icp_*, cro_rewritten_copy, design_tokens — reused so any funnel visuals/pages match the client's established design system.

fields.label: Competitor Funnel Analysis
fields.raw_explanation: Step 1C / Step 2: the approved competitor listing from `competitor_analysis_funnel` — each competitor's funnel entry page, funnel type (entry offer → next step), what the gate asks for and any stated follow-up. Step 2 maps funnel-type distribution, the lead-magnet landscape and the market's value ladder from it, and Step 3A ties the funnel's differentiation to the gaps it shows.

fields.label: Client Website URL (live reference)
fields.raw_explanation: Step 1E: "If any of the above context is incomplete or unclear, browse the client's website (URL established earlier in this conversation) to fill gaps. Do not invent information." Per REVIEW_NEEDED_V2.md item 8 resolution, this is a new `source` taxonomy value distinct from user_input/auto_from_context: a live fetch of the client's own site at generation time, not a stored context-store read.
